answer_1.quote: We propose a novel approach to discover and compare social norms conditioned on social situations across Chinese and American cultures.

answer_2.quote: Following Chakrabarty et al. (2022), we evaluate the quality of model-generated explanations using the explanation score metric: an average of BLEURT and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Three students with significant lived experiences (10+ years) in Chinese and American cultures assessed the quality of a subset of 50 randomly chosen model-generated explanations for correctly predicted labels, evaluating performance between the best performing model finetuned only on related tasks (T5-eSNLI) and the best-performing model that was directly fine-tuned on our dataset (T5-SocNorm).
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was asked to rate which generated explanation they preferred, allowing for the presence of ties.
